games.name: Slap Battles Tower Defense
games.desc:
slap

If Slap battles and Tower defense genre had a child then it would be like this! 
Slap Battles Tower Defense (sbtd for short) is a Tower Defense game themed to Slap Battles!

- Slap enemies for slaps (pro currency name ik).
- Place towers and upgrade them to defeat the bosses!
- Buy new towers, and create your own tower empire!
Become the strongest in the world.

Beat waves and slap alot of enemies 🧟‍♂️ in order to get super cool shiny stars! ⭐
Use the stars ⭐ to buy new towers. 🧱 There are over 50!
Lots of towers 🧱 have special powers. 🔮 Try to unlock them all!

If you've liked the game, you can support us by giving a thumbs up 👍 and a favorite ⭐. It would be really appreciated! 😄

If you're missing data, check the group forums for info on why or to ask for help.
